installCommand: if [ -z "$WINDMORPH_PRO_TOKEN" ]; then echo "WINDMORPH_PRO_TOKEN is not set for this Vercel environment (Production/Preview)." >&2; exit 1; fi && git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${WINDMORPH_PRO_TOKEN}@github.com/XManhTrinh/windmorph-pro".insteadOf "https://github.com/XManhTrinh/windmorph-pro" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
